# 1. Figure 1A -- Plot for APM mutations + HLA LOH + homozygous deletion
```{r}
# APM_event = HLAmut + HLALOH + nonHLAmut + noHLA_HD
HLALOH_pcawg <- fread(paste0(path_APMall, "LOH_MSI_final_TMB_CNA.csv")) %>% 
  #subset(MSI_mut == "MSS") %>% 
  mutate(APM_Event = factor(APM_Event, levels = c("APM-WT", "APM-Mutant"))) 
table(HLALOH_pcawg$APM_Event)

patient_freq <- HLALOH_pcawg %>% mutate(count = 1)

TCGA_sum <- patient_freq %>%
  group_by(histology_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(Total_all = sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(histology_abbreviation, Total_all)

TCGA_proj <- patient_freq %>%
  group_by(histology_abbreviation, APM_Event) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(histology_abbreviation) %>%
  filter(all(c("APM-WT", "APM-Mutant") %in% APM_Event)) %>%
  ungroup()

sum(TCGA_proj$Total)

prop_df <- TCGA_proj %>%
  group_by(histology_abbreviation) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(Total),
    prop = Total / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(APM_Event == "APM-Mutant") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 1)))

## Plot for HLAmut + HLALOH + nonHLAmut + noHLA_HD
APM_freq <- ggplot(TCGA_proj, aes(x = histology_abbreviation, y = Total, fill = APM_Event)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_APM_envet) +
  labs(x = "",  y = "Numbers of Samples", fill = "APM Event") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,  vjust = 1, size = 16, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),  
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5, l = 30, r = 20, b = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(TCGA_sum$Total_all) + 20)) +
  geom_text(
    data = prop_df,
    aes(x = histology_abbreviation, y = total, label = label),
    vjust = -0.3,
    hjust = 0.5,
    size = 4.5
  )

ggsave(filename = paste0(path_figure, "/Figure1A.pdf"), plot = APM_freq, width = 14, height = 6, units = "in")
```
